product.title: Cosrx AHA/BHA Clarifying Treatment Toner
product.body_html:
Infused with AHA, BHA, and natural botanical extracts, the AHA/BHA Clarifying Treatment Toner is designed to calm, refresh, and soften the skin. Its unique formula combines AHA and BHA acids with plant-based ingredients to refine skin texture, boost radiance, and minimize the appearance of pores. This all-in-one product cleanses, exfoliates, and hydrates simultaneously. With 10% white willow bark extract and 10% apple water, it effectively soothes irritation. The toner gently exfoliates while panthenol and allantoin deeply moisturize and provide a comforting feel to the skin.

SIZE : 150ml / 5.07 fl. oz  

BENEFITS

• Exfoliate surface of skin
• Smooths and softens
• Clear congested pores
• Balance oil production

TARGETS

• Beginners to chemical exfoliation
• Gentle, soft exfoliation
• Daily use
• All skin types including Sensitive Skin

HOW TO USE

After cleansing your skin, spray the toner onto a cotton pad and softly sweep it across your face, steering clear of the eye and lip areas. If applying during the daytime, ensure you finish with a broad-spectrum sunscreen with an SPF of 30 or higher.

INGREDIENTS

Water, Salix Alba (Willow) Bark Water, Pyrus Malus (Apple) Fruit Water, Butylene Glycol, 1,2-Hexanediol, Sodium Lactate, Glycolic Acid, Betaine Salicylate, Allantoin, Panthenol, Ethyl Hexanediol
